text: R17 residuals (out of scope, lead decision 2026-11-02): (1) FRESH_SEED authorization carrier - the startup owner's FRESH_SEED outcome held as a node-local token for the seed's own lone groups; owner: seed/startup release lineage (fresh-seed-activation, seed-release-once-per-partition-cohort). (2) OPERATOR authorization carrier - the explicit operator release issued at the leader; owner: the participant-release operator entry (TX1 cutover proposal :323-337). No cross-node failure witness exists for either.

Condition (e) considered and rejected (lead 2026-11-02): requiring every member of the leader's committed configuration to be a GENESIS founder would turn a legitimately fresh group whose committed configuration changed before release (a learner admitted by the rebalancer, a founder replaced) into a permanent OPERATOR_REQUIRED - a new orphan path of the class being removed (R11/R12). Conditions (a)-(d) already refuse a restored legacy group (no open GENESIS founding create row naming the answering leader's replica). Condition (f) added: NOT_LEADER is answered before any authority read.

R17 findings from quest B's approving verification (coverage gaps, to be closed in this quest): C1 - dropping the resumeSyncingReplicaCreateStatus report survives the witnesses; needs a local-CREATING + durable-SYNCING witness. C2 - ignoring admissibility in replicaCreatePhaseAfterResume survives (5 files / 706 assertions); needs a PENDING-restart control. C3 - status-less row semantics differ between isPeerRowStatusAdmissible (a row without status is live) and replicaCreatePhaseAfterResume (no status leaves the phase); unreachable via RESTART_CREATE today; settle when the admission-input boundary moves to the requestReplicaAdmission send.

Post-landing finding against fresh-create-failure-after-committed-admission-v2 (landed bba206ddd; a solved quest takes no entries, so recorded here): test/node/replica-handler-owner-path-bypass.test.js assertion 10 'retryable failure preserves its owner retry type' (:1070) is red at bba206ddd, green at base 311695504 - candidate-specific and deterministic (hosted first pass and retry, lab cone, local). Mechanism: the {label:'retryable', deferRetry:true} case (:917) fails deferRetry in waitForVoterReadyActivation (:980-992), after the runtime opened; the -v2 rule claims cleanup and emits no deferRetry for it, while the guard (terminal-create-runtime-lifecycle-fence-v2, bf82f7d58) asserts deferRetry is preserved. No owner path is bypassed (all other assertions pass; the subtest's own K3 re-drive half, :1092-1097, already refuses re-driving a learner that reached SYNCING). A contract conflict missed by -v2's focused lanes; disposition (an explicit R09 supersession of assertion 10 in a successor, expecting no deferRetry and a cleanup claim) awaits the lead.
